def transform(grid):
    # A solid horizontal separator divides two aligned masks. Mark their overlap.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]

def transform(grid):
    # A solid vertical divider separates two aligned binary masks.
    divider = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
                   if all(row[c] != 0 and all(v == row[c] for v in [row[c]])
                          for row in grid)
                   and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
